name: Solend DAO governance realm

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Two bare wallets sit above the DAO vote: one can rewrite the voting rules with no proposal, the other can replace the governance program's code. Neither is renounced, and the DAO has not taken over the realm authority.
narrative.tag: retroactive backtest of the June 2022 vote
narrative.detail: Solend runs its own governance program, not the shared default instance, confirmed live. The realm authority is an active on-curve wallet, and the governance program's upgrade authority is another one. The token-vote path has no council, a 1% yes threshold as decoded (not confirmed by a second method), no execution hold-up and 3 days of voting. In the June 2022 backtest, SLND1 passed with 97.46% yes after a 6-hour vote and SLND2 reversed it the next day; neither touched the realm authority. The backtest is retrospective, not a live catch. The flat token-voting baseline ignores vote concentration, an open gap.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it
